mods.name: Create Aeronautics: Vapor Trails
mods.description:
Client-side atmospheric particle effects for Create Aeronautics / Sable ships:
wingtip vapor trails, propeller blade-tip vortices and prop wash, engine smoke,
hover dust, water wakes and cloud-punch bursts. 100% client-side - works on any server.

releases.notes:
Assembly and disassembly effects. Every other effect in the mod only exists once a ship is already flying; this one covers the moment every airship player is guaranteed to experience while standing right next to it.

Assemble a ship and the ground beneath it blows outward in a ring of block-appropriate dust while debris shakes loose from the underside as it tears free. Take one apart and it settles back into the world under a heavier, slower plume. Both are one-shot and sized to the ship - nothing repeats during normal flight.

Flying away from a ship never triggers it: Sable distinguishes a real disassembly from a ship simply unloading, and a seen-id check stops reloads firing false bursts. New assembly config section (enabled, intensity, triggerRange).

releases.notes:
Compatibility fix: the mod now runs on any NeoForge 21.1.x build. It previously declared [21.1.233,) and refused to load on anything older, despite using no API newer than 21.1.1 - which locked it out of most packs and servers pinning earlier builds.

The floor is now enforced rather than assumed: the mod compiles against 21.1.1 itself, so the compiler rejects anything newer. Verify with ./gradlew compileJava -Pneo_version=21.1.1

No functional changes. Other Minecraft versions remain out of scope since Sable and Create Aeronautics are both 1.21.1 only.

mods.description:
Client-side atmospheric particle effects for Create Aeronautics / Sable ships:
wingtip vapor trails, propeller blade-tip vortices and prop wash, engine smoke,
hover dust, water wakes and cloud-punch bursts. 100% client-side - works on any server.

releases.notes:
Wake turbulence: fast ships now shed counter-rotating vortices from their wingtips that linger in the air for about twenty seconds after the visible trail has faded. Cross another ship's flight path - or your own, on a tight turn - and your vapor is torn apart as you hit their wake. Flying into disturbed air draws it out as ragged vapor so you can see what you hit.

Cores use a Rankine vortex profile and a spatial hash, shedding is independent of the visible trails, and a ship ignores its own wake for the first two seconds so nothing shakes itself apart on takeoff. New wakeTurbulence config section: enabled, lifetimeSeconds, strength, reveal.

mods.name: Create Aeronautics: Vapor Trails
mods.description:
Client-side atmospheric particle effects for Create Aeronautics / Sable ships:
wingtip vapor trails, propeller blade-tip vortices and prop wash, engine smoke,
hover dust, water wakes and cloud-punch bursts. 100% client-side - works on any server.

releases.notes: Effects now spawn on the pose the ship is drawn at, not the logical one, so particles stop trailing the hull at speed. Angular velocity is now part of the physics: a rotating hull moves its extremities faster than its centre, so wingtips are gated on their own airspeed and a hard bank finally streams vapor from the rising tip. Blade-tip rings read the propeller's real rendered angle instead of integrating from kinetic speed, so they stay in step with the blades through spin-up and spin-down.

releases.notes: Hull effects now use each ship's real block silhouette instead of its bounding box. Wingtip trails come off the actual wingtips (span axis resolved in ship space, so banking works), hover dust samples columns that genuinely contain blocks, and wake/shock-cone extents no longer inflate when a hull sits at an angle to the world axes. The scan is incremental so big ships never hitch; disable with hullShapeScan = false.
